value.text:
Jilin Business and Technology College (吉林工商学院) is a public provincial higher-education institution in Jiutai District, Changchun, Jilin Province, China. It provides full-time undergraduate education, alongside junior-college programmes. Its academic provision includes business administration, accounting, finance, taxation, economics and international trade, as well as computing, engineering, food-related subjects and foreign languages.

The present institution was formed in March 2007 through the merger of 吉林财税高等专科学校, 吉林商业高等专科学校 and 吉林粮食高等专科学校. This merger is a distinct milestone in its institutional history. In September 2014, the college moved as a whole into the newly built Kalun Lake campus.

The college’s teaching structure includes schools covering business, accounting, finance, taxation, economics and trade, grain and food studies, foreign languages, media arts, tourism and cooking. Listed programmes range from logistics management and applied statistics to electronic information engineering, artificial intelligence, food quality and safety, English, Japanese, animation and hotel management. The institution reported 15,772 students and 952 employees for 2023; these figures describe that reporting year. Its published programme list includes both undergraduate and junior-college offerings. The article lists 14 teaching units, 46 undergraduate programmes and 15 junior-college programmes, without assigning these figures a reporting year.
